response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(link_to_major) <> '' GROUP BY link_to_major), s AS (SELECT link_to_major, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT link_to_major, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS avg_share_of_selected, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing major means link_to_major is NULL or an empty/blank string; such members are excluded before computing counts, totals and averages.
The average share across groups is the unweighted mean of the group shares (which equals 1 / number of groups). Groups with share exactly equal to the average are excluded (strictly above).
